title: CompileRequest
description: The runtime's public compile input (spec §12, V1 subset).

candidates.description: Registry ids of candidate tools, in candidate order (≤16 in V1). `None` = use all registered tools (error if more than 16).

locale.description: BCP-47, e.g. `de-DE`. Defaults to the compiler config.

now.description: RFC 3339 override of "now" for deterministic resolution in tests/eval.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`. Defaults to the compiler config.

CharSpan.description: `[start, end)` character offsets (host-facing; token spans are the model-facing form).

ContextEntity.description: A known conversational context entity (generic; hosts without a selection model can use this instead of [`LinkedItem`]).

LinkedItem.description: An element the user linked into the chat — the host's current selection. Arguments may bind these instead of extracting from the utterance ("tag *this*"), which is what makes an in-application router useful.

ref.description: Stable handle within this request (`L1`, `L2`, …) that argument provenance points at.

type.description: Host element type (`asset`, `document`, `object`, …). Tools disagree on the symbol for the same thing (`object` vs `data-object`), so the binding layer maps it per tool rather than assuming one vocabulary.

RequestContext.description: Everything the host knows about the moment the utterance was typed.

linked.description: Items linked into the chat (the current selection).

selection_count.description: Total selection size when it exceeds what `linked` enumerates — the signal that a request is bulk and may exceed a tool's per-call cap.

studio_view.description: Where in the host UI the user is (list, detail, …).

ResolverCandidate.description: One candidate interpretation of an identifier-like token.

ResolverEntry.description: The host's identifier pre-pass: integer-like tokens in the utterance, looked up before the model runs. An empty `candidates` list means "not found", which is deliberately indistinguishable from "no permission".
